summary: Apps can search for unconfigured wireless accessories, pick a Bluetooth device and get connection notices for USB and external accessories. The privacy-preserving discovery flow, where a picker grants access without a permission prompt, is not built.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run in this batch); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: an app matches unconfigured accessories by criteria and starts a configuration
an app asks for nearby devices and the user chooses one
a registry of connected accessories and listeners for attach and detach; no authorized state per accessory

features.apple: ASMigrationDisplayItem, accessory authorization without Bluetooth permission
features.note: no picker that grants access without a permission prompt

gaps: No picker that grants access to an accessory without a permission prompt.
No migration of previously discovered accessories.
